races.name: Rootkin
races.description: Tree-aliens. Control and economy; a slow start that snowballs. Towers grow stronger the longer they stand.

races.name: The Assembly
races.description: A machine collective. Raw damage and armor; its construction crew is the Phase 1 enemy.

races.name: Chitin Swarm
races.description: Insectoid hive. Numbers, cheap towers, acid damage over time.

races.name: Lumenari
races.description: Energy beings. Few expensive towers; range, piercing beams, time tricks.
